items.source: Maintains a mapping between native levels and LogLevel.
items.translation: 维护本地级别与LogLevel之间的映射。

items.source: Reset the logging system to be limit output. This method may be called before LoggingSystem.initialize(LoggingInitializationContext, String, LogFile) to reduce logging noise until the system has been fully initialized.
items.translation: 重置日志系统以限制输出。此方法可在调用 LoggingSystem.initialize(LoggingInitializationContext, String, LogFile) 之前执行，以减少系统在完全初始化之前的日志噪音。

items.source: Return any self initialization config that has been applied. By default this method checks getStandardConfigLocations() and assumes that any file that exists will have been applied.
items.translation: 返回任何已应用的自我初始化配置。默认情况下，此方法检查getStandardConfigLocations()，并假设任何存在的文件都已被应用。

items.source: Return any spring specific initialization config that should be applied. By default this method checks getSpringConfigLocations().
items.translation: 返回任何应应用的 Spring 特定初始化配置。默认情况下，此方法会检查getSpringConfigLocations()。

items.source: Return the spring config locations for this system. By default this method returns a set of locations based on getStandardConfigLocations().
items.translation: 返回此系统的 Spring 配置位置。默认情况下，此方法返回一组基于getStandardConfigLocations()的位置。

items.source: Reinitialize the logging system if required. Called when getSelfInitializationConfig() is used and the log file hasn't changed. May be used to reload configuration (for example to pick up additional System properties).
items.translation: 如需要则重新初始化日志系统。当使用getSelfInitializationConfig()且日志文件未更改时调用。可用于重新加载配置（例如以获取额外的 System 属性）。

items.source: Return the default log correlation pattern or null if log correlation patterns are not supported.
items.translation: 返回默认日志关联模式，或者如果日志关联模式不受支持则返回 null`。

items.source: Return the default value resolver to use when resolving system properties.
items.translation: 返回用于解析系统属性的默认值解析器。

items.source: Return the standard config locations for this system.
items.translation: 返回此系统的标准配置位置。

items.source: Fully initialize the logging system.
items.translation: 完全初始化日志系统。

items.source: Load sensible defaults for the logging system.
items.translation: 为日志系统加载合理的默认值。
